classification: candidate formalization design; no source admission or world-truth proof

constant.meaning: one named element of the result sort

partial-function.core_lowering: Explicit definedness plus result or relational graph; no implicit default value

predicate.meaning: Boolean-valued relation; arity may be zero for a proposition

record.core_lowering: Explicit carrier/fields/constraints; shape does not authenticate owners or effects

relation.meaning: typed ordered tuples; symmetry/transitivity/multiplicity only if explicitly stated

sort.default_domain: nonempty; predicate population requirements separately declared

state-transition-trace.core_lowering: Static state/transition relations supported; trace semantics require an extension contract

total-function.meaning: exactly one result for every argument tuple

free_variables: Queries closed after explicit parameter/environment binding; unbound variables malformed.

identity.alignment: Reviewed common-carrier map required before cross-identity comparison
identity.labels: display only; equal labels do not merge exact keys

ill_typed_outcome: malformed before semantic evaluation; not false and not supported absence
semantic_primitive_boundary: A locally governed primitive is not a programming scalar type or automatic authority claim.
typing_judgments: Gamma |- f(args) : result-sort only when arity and all argument sorts match
Gamma |- P(args) : Formula only when its signature matches
Gamma |- t=u : Formula only on an explicitly common sort
Gamma,x:S |- body : Formula implies Gamma |- forall/exists x:S.body : Formula
